description.value: This independently owned and operated Subway franchise sits on the Hillside corridor in Victoria, offering made-to-order Footlongs, 6-inch sandwiches, wraps, and salads with fresh-cut vegetables and fresh-baked bread. The location supports pick-up, delivery, and curbside pickup, making it a straightforward stop for cyclists moving through the neighbourhood. It also offers breakfast and catering service.
